eventDetail.scope: This conference aims to provide a unified platform for advanced and multidisciplinary research in the design and development of smart computing and informatics systems. The conference focuses on emerging innovation paradigms in system knowledge, artificial intelligence, and sustainable technologies that can provide practical solutions to challenges in society, environment, industry, and healthcare. The scope of the conference extends to the development and deployment of emerging computational techniques, intelligent systems, knowledge transfer approaches, and optimization solutions across diverse disciplines of science, engineering, and technology. The conference will encourage collaboration among researchers, academicians, and industry professionals to exchange ideas and present cutting-edge research that contributes to the advancement of smart and sustainable technologies. Track 1: Smart Computing Track 2: Image and Signal Processing Track 3: IoT and Automation
